inputs.goal: cover the 110-page contained sci-fi thriller against a low-budget mandate

read.synopsis: A group of survivors trapped in an abandoned research facility must uncover the truth behind a mysterious outbreak that has turned their colleagues into violent, mutated creatures.
beats: Exposition: The protagonists are scientists working on a cutting-edge experiment gone wrong.
Inciting Incident: An accident triggers an outbreak, leaving them isolated and trapped.
Conflict: They must navigate the facility while avoiding infected colleagues.
Climax: Discovering the origin of the mutation and finding a potential cure or escape.
Resolution: The decision to stay and fight against the odds or find a way out.

structure_notes.rationale: The story structure is solid for a low-budget setting with clear arcs and escalating tension. The contained environment amplifies suspense.

shards.value: The thriller elements of the story can be emphasized through tight pacing and focus on suspense techniques.
Developing well-defined characteristics for key protagonists can help audiences invest in their journey, even with minimal resources.
The research facility setting offers ample opportunities for low-cost production through creative use of space and environment.

comparables.map.shard_result: To emphasize the thriller elements on a low-budget mandate, focus on tight pacing (short scenes, quick cuts), creative use of lighting and shadows for suspense, and effective use of sound design to heighten tension without relying heavily on expensive visual effects.

cost_efficient_set_dressing.idea: Leverage existing research facility sets by limiting action to key labs and corridors
Use practical effects for creature gore rather than expensive CGI

creative_lighting.idea: Implement dynamic lighting changes to create mood and tension in a cost-effective way

comps.reason: Found footage format allows for realistic portrayal of events in contained spaces

comps.title: [REC]
comps.reason: Intense claustrophobia and horror achieved with minimal set-ups inside an apartment building

comps.title: Coherence
comps.reason: Effective suspense using time loop concept within a single house

comparables.reduce.output: To cover the 110-page contained sci-fi thriller on a low budget, focus on the following elements: 1. Use handheld camera techniques and found footage style to create immediacy without expensive equipment. 2. Maintain a single location or minimal set changes like in '[REC]' and 'Coherence'. 3. Leverage practical effects for gore and rely on lighting for suspense rather than CGI. 4. Keep the cast small and focus character development through clear archetypes.
